facts.fact: TechCabal says Communications Minister Bosun Tijani released the National Digital Cloud Policy in August 2026, with NITDA's supporting cloud guidelines.
NIPOST says the policy directs federal agencies to meet cloud hosting needs through the government's shared services model, with Galaxy Backbone as provider.
NIPOST says its core postcode database is hosted and managed by Galaxy Backbone, an arrangement it bases on the National Digital Cloud Policy.
